title: GEMglDepthRange
description: specify mapping of depth values from normalized device coordinates to window coordinates

messages.description: mapping of the near clipping plane to window coordinates
mapping of the far clipping plane to window coordinates

arguments.description: mapping of the near clipping plane to window coordinates
mapping of the far clipping plane to window coordinates

body: [GEMglDepthRange] calls glDepthRange() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glDepthRange in the OpenGL reference.
